title: credential-throttle-and-polyglot-retry-wrappers
author: Elena Vazquez
description: Adds a small, cross-sdk credential throttling / backoff mediator and thin retry wrapper bindings for Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to prevent thundering-reauth storms when upstream token services return transient 401/429 spikes. Motivation: we saw two incidents where concurrent token refresh attempts saturated the auth service and caused cascade failures; this change introduces a per-tenant in-process token gate with exponential-jittered backoff windows, a shared fallback queue that serializes refresh attempts, and a lightweight retry shim that standardizes retry predicate/timeout semantics across SDKs. The PR touches runtime glue in redwood/sdk-packaging and the three SDK packages to wire the mediator, plus tests and docs. release_notes: Introduce optional credential throttling mediator to prevent auth-service storms; opt-in via client config (credentialThrottle.enabled=true). Adds cross-SDK retry wrapper to align retry predicates and jittered exponential backoff. SDKs bumped: python->0.35.1, typescript->2.18.0, go->v1.5.7. Telemetry: cred.throttle.contention, cred.throttle.queue_len, cred.backoff.window_ms. No behavioral breaking changes by default; config opt-in.
